subject: general
question:
How can paper waste be minimised?

I. By discarding

II. By recycling

III. By reusing

IV. By burning
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II and III**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most effective way to reduce waste generation is by recycling.
 
• This is because recycling helps in reducing the amount of waste that goes into landfills and helps conserve natural resources.
 
• Here are some of the reasons why recycling is the most effective way to reduce waste generation:
 
• Reduces the amount of waste going to landfills:
 
 
• ​Recycling helps in reducing the amount of waste that goes into landfills.
 
• This is because when we recycle, we are reusing materials that would otherwise end up in landfills.
 
 
 
• Conserves natural resources:
 
 
• Recycling helps conserve natural resources like timber, water, and minerals.
 
• By recycling materials like paper, plastic, and metal, we are reducing the need to extract new resources from the environment.
 
 
 
• Reduces greenhouse gas emissions:
 
 
• Recycling also helps in reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• This is because when we recycle materials, we are using less energy than we would if we were to extract new resources from the environment.
 
 
 
• Creates jobs:
 
 
• Recycling also creates jobs in the recycling industry.
 
• This is because recycling requires people to collect, sort, and process materials, and these jobs help stimulate the economy.
